title: D³ETOR: Debate-Enhanced Pseudo Labeling and Frequency-Aware Progressive Debiasing for Weakly-Supervised Camouflaged Object Detection with Scribble Annotations

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the spatial discrepancy between scribble annotations and ground truth masks (measuring distance to object boundaries) and evaluating model performance using a debias loss that dynamically re-weights segmentation supervision based on the predicted likelihood of pixels being annotated, mitigating annotators' preference for central object regions.
